name: @w6w-apps/replyio
description: Manage contacts, sequences, email accounts and reporting in Reply.io — sales engagement and multichannel outreach.

w6w.longDescription:
Reply.io is a sales engagement platform for multichannel outreach — email sequences, LinkedIn, and calls. This app covers the v3 REST API, the surface Reply's own docs say to use going forward (v1/v2 are documented as deprecated).

It manages contacts (create, update, delete, filter with structured rules), sequences — Reply's name for a multi-step outreach campaign (list, get, create, start, pause, enroll contacts, list enrolled contacts), email accounts (list, get), custom fields, and the team-wide email reporting overview.

Authentication is a Bearer API key. The credential-liveness probe is `GET /v3/whoami`, which Reply's own docs single out as needing no scope and returning only `{userId, username, teamId}` — never the key itself. Health also tracks Reply's own status page (`status.reply.io`), which sits behind a Cloudflare rule that blocks requests carrying no `User-Agent` header — including curl's default-stripped and bare `Mozilla/5.0` — so the probe sends an explicit one.
